description: Image Description: The image is a black and white photograph showing the back seat of a car. On the seat, there is a metallic hard-shell suitcase lying flat. Resting on top of the suitcase is a fish wrapped in aluminum foil. The fish's head is visible, and the foil tightly covers its body. There is a fabric item, possibly a piece of clothing or a bag, partially visible next to the suitcase. The car seat has a textured surface and a seatbelt can be seen,
